s: November 6, 2025 - "Tender Kisses" is a song by American singer–songwriter Tracie Spencer. This song is the fourth single released from Spencer's second album, Make the Difference which was released in August 1990. The single was released on July 16, 1991. The song was written by Matt Sherrod & Paul Sherrod, Sir Spence, and Tracie Spencer, and produced by Matt & Paul Sherrod.
